title: 隧道收斂量測~Tunnel convergence monitoring
focus: 用多方向位移、量測基準與支護時序辨識隧道收斂機制~Identify convergence mechanisms through multidirectional movement, survey references and support timing
summary: 本課聚焦用多方向位移、量測基準與支護時序辨識隧道收斂機制。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on identify convergence mechanisms through multidirectional movement, survey references and support timing. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 收斂弦長與方向~Convergence chords and direction
units.title: 收斂弦長與方向~Convergence chords and direction
units.mechanism: 收斂弦量到兩點間距變化，不等於每點的絕對位移。水平弦縮短可能來自側壁內移或整個斷面轉動，只有加入垂直、斜向弦與坐標才能分辨對稱擠壓及偏壓。 假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。 兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。~A convergence chord measures separation change, not absolute movement at either endpoint. Horizontal shortening may reflect inward movement or section rotation; vertical and diagonal chords plus coordinates distinguish symmetric squeezing from asymmetric loading. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015. Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015.
units.verify: 用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。~Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates.
units.failure: 兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。~Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates.
units.misconception: 兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。~An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄收斂弦長與方向的資料來源與適用條件。用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for convergence chords and direction. Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord.

units.anchor: 初始讀值與已發生變形~Initial readings and prior movement
units.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形~Initial readings and prior movement
units.mechanism: 量測只能看到首讀之後的變化，掌子面到達與裝設測點之間已發生的位移不在紀錄內。首讀里程、時間與支護狀態需一起保存，否則不同斷面會因量測起點不同而看似岩性差異。 假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。 晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。~Monitoring captures movement after the first reading, omitting displacement before installation. Preserve initial face distance, time and support state; otherwise different monitoring origins can masquerade as geological differences between sections. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured. A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured.
units.verify: 對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。~Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions.
units.failure: 晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。~A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions.
units.misconception: 較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。~Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄初始讀值與已發生變形的資料來源與適用條件。對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for initial readings and prior movement. Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use.

units.anchor: 角度精度與觀測距離~Angular precision and sight distance
units.title: 角度精度與觀測距離~Angular precision and sight distance
units.mechanism: 全測站角度誤差隨觀測距離轉成線性位置誤差，長視線不一定有更好的收斂精度。隧道熱流、折射與遮擋又造成非隨機偏差，必須把儀器標稱值和現場重複性分開。 假設視距100 m、角度誤差5 arcsec，線性誤差100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm。 暖風造成的折射會讓相同方向測點共同偏移，系統可能把它解讀成斷面傾斜；只靠單一測站的內部精度指標無法發現這種偏差。~Total-station angular error becomes a distance-dependent position error. Long sights therefore need not improve convergence precision, and tunnel thermal refraction and obstruction add nonrandom bias beyond the nominal instrument rating. For assumed sight distance 100 m and angular error 5 arcsec, linear error is 100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm. Thermal refraction can move targets coherently in one direction and mimic section tilt. Internal precision statistics from one station cannot reveal that shared directional error.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設視距100 m、角度誤差5 arcsec，線性誤差100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed sight distance 100 m and angular error 5 arcsec, linear error is 100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm.
units.verify: 以不同設站、正倒鏡及穩定參考點重複觀測，記錄溫度梯度與可視條件；將現場重複散布和預期變形量比較，若噪音同量級則需調整測網而非增加輸出小數位。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：暖風造成的折射會讓相同方向測點共同偏移，系統可能把它解讀成斷面傾斜；只靠單一測站的內部精度指標無法發現這種偏差。~Repeat observations from different stations and faces with stable references and document thermal and visibility conditions; compare field scatter with expected movement, redesigning the network rather than adding decimals when they are comparable. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Thermal refraction can move targets coherently in one direction and mimic section tilt. Internal precision statistics from one station cannot reveal that shared directional error.
units.failure: 暖風造成的折射會讓相同方向測點共同偏移，系統可能把它解讀成斷面傾斜；只靠單一測站的內部精度指標無法發現這種偏差。~Thermal refraction can move targets coherently in one direction and mimic section tilt. Internal precision statistics from one station cannot reveal that shared directional error.
units.misconception: 全測站角度精度固定，所以位置誤差與觀測距離無關。~Fixed total-station angular precision makes positional error independent of sight distance.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄角度精度與觀測距離的資料來源與適用條件。以不同設站、正倒鏡及穩定參考點重複觀測，記錄溫度梯度與可視條件；將現場重複散布和預期變形量比較，若噪音同量級則需調整測網而非增加輸出小數位。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for angular precision and sight distance. Repeat observations from different stations and faces with stable references and document thermal and visibility conditions; compare field scatter with expected movement, redesigning the network rather than adding decimals when they are comparable.

units.anchor: 鋼尺溫度與張力~Tape temperature and tension
units.title: 鋼尺溫度與張力~Tape temperature and tension
units.mechanism: 收斂尺量長受熱膨脹、拉力及垂度影響，讀值變化不必然是岩體運動。應使用校正條件換算到共同基準，且確認標距和接頭重複定位，否則日夜溫差會形成假的週期變形。 假設鋼尺α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長10 m、溫差10 K，ΔL=αLΔT=1.2 mm；未含垂度。 溫度補償符號用反會把膨脹加倍，量測人員張力不同又可造成班次跳值；若未查校正紀錄，就可能對不存在的變形採取施工調整。~Tape length responds to temperature, tension and sag as well as ground movement. Convert readings to a common calibration condition and verify gauge length and seating, or day-night temperature variation will mimic cyclic convergence. Assume steel-tape α=12×10⁻⁶/K, length 10 m and temperature change 10 K; ΔL=1.2 mm, excluding sag. A reversed temperature correction doubles thermal error, while inconsistent tension produces shift changes. Missing calibration review may prompt construction changes in response to movement that never occurred.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鋼尺α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長10 m、溫差10 K，ΔL=αLΔT=1.2 mm；未含垂度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume steel-tape α=12×10⁻⁶/K, length 10 m and temperature change 10 K; ΔL=1.2 mm, excluding sag.
units.verify: 在固定基線檢查尺長及重複張力，記錄量測時尺體溫度而非只用遠處氣溫；保留原讀值與各修正項，以獨立光學量測核對，修正後仍異常才作地工解釋。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：溫度補償符號用反會把膨脹加倍，量測人員張力不同又可造成班次跳值；若未查校正紀錄，就可能對不存在的變形採取施工調整。~Check tape length and repeatable tension on a fixed baseline and record tape temperature rather than distant air temperature; retain raw readings and corrections and compare optical observations before interpreting persistent anomalies geotechnically. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A reversed temperature correction doubles thermal error, while inconsistent tension produces shift changes. Missing calibration review may prompt construction changes in response to movement that never occurred.
units.failure: 溫度補償符號用反會把膨脹加倍，量測人員張力不同又可造成班次跳值；若未查校正紀錄，就可能對不存在的變形採取施工調整。~A reversed temperature correction doubles thermal error, while inconsistent tension produces shift changes. Missing calibration review may prompt construction changes in response to movement that never occurred.
units.misconception: 鋼尺讀值變化只能是圍岩變形，不會受溫度和張力影響。~A steel-tape reading changes only with ground movement, never temperature or tension.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄鋼尺溫度與張力的資料來源與適用條件。在固定基線檢查尺長及重複張力，記錄量測時尺體溫度而非只用遠處氣溫；保留原讀值與各修正項，以獨立光學量測核對，修正後仍異常才作地工解釋。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for tape temperature and tension. Check tape length and repeatable tension on a fixed baseline and record tape temperature rather than distant air temperature; retain raw readings and corrections and compare optical observations before interpreting persistent anomalies geotechnically.

units.anchor: 參考點穩定與共模~Reference stability and common motion
units.title: 參考點穩定與共模~Reference stability and common motion
units.mechanism: 洞內設站點也可能隨開挖移動，所有測點共模位移可能來自設站而非圍岩。測網需連到影響區外控制，並利用相對弦長與絕對坐標互查，使局部變形和整體基準漂移可分辨。 假設三點皆向右5 mm且弦長不變，可能為共同平移；差分位移5−5=0 mm，不能據此宣稱絕對不動。 把設站漂移當偏壓會誤改支護，反過來將真實整體位移一律扣除也會掩蓋隧道移動；只保留校正後曲線無法查明哪種情況發生。~Underground stations can move during excavation, creating common apparent displacement. Link the network to external controls and compare relative chords with absolute coordinates to distinguish local distortion from reference drift. If three assumed targets all move 5 mm right with unchanged chords, their differential movement is zero; this does not demonstrate absolute stability. Mistaking station drift for asymmetric ground pressure misdirects support, while subtracting all common motion can hide real tunnel translation. Corrected curves alone cannot establish which situation occurred.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三點皆向右5 mm且弦長不變，可能為共同平移；差分位移5−5=0 mm，不能據此宣稱絕對不動。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If three assumed targets all move 5 mm right with unchanged chords, their differential movement is zero; this does not demonstrate absolute stability.
units.verify: 檢查外部控制與設站殘差，重算以不同基準約束的位移場；對共模與差分量分別報告，任何基準重設須保存轉換矩陣並經測量主管核准，避免歷程被強制歸零。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把設站漂移當偏壓會誤改支護，反過來將真實整體位移一律扣除也會掩蓋隧道移動；只保留校正後曲線無法查明哪種情況發生。~Inspect external controls and station residuals and recompute with alternative reference constraints; report common and differential motion separately and retain approved transformation matrices for any datum reset instead of forcing the history to zero. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking station drift for asymmetric ground pressure misdirects support, while subtracting all common motion can hide real tunnel translation. Corrected curves alone cannot establish which situation occurred.
units.failure: 把設站漂移當偏壓會誤改支護，反過來將真實整體位移一律扣除也會掩蓋隧道移動；只保留校正後曲線無法查明哪種情況發生。~Mistaking station drift for asymmetric ground pressure misdirects support, while subtracting all common motion can hide real tunnel translation. Corrected curves alone cannot establish which situation occurred.
units.misconception: 所有測點共同位移時，一定可以全部扣除當作基準漂移。~Common movement of all targets can always be subtracted as reference drift.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄參考點穩定與共模的資料來源與適用條件。檢查外部控制與設站殘差，重算以不同基準約束的位移場；對共模與差分量分別報告，任何基準重設須保存轉換矩陣並經測量主管核准，避免歷程被強制歸零。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for reference stability and common motion. Inspect external controls and station residuals and recompute with alternative reference constraints; report common and differential motion separately and retain approved transformation matrices for any datum reset instead of forcing the history to zero.

units.anchor: 面距與變形速率~Face distance and movement rate
units.title: 面距與變形速率~Face distance and movement rate
units.mechanism: 靠近掌子面的三維支承效應隨面距消退，收斂對時間的變化也受開挖停頓影響。把位移同時對時間與面距繪圖，才能區分施工推進造成的釋放與岩體持續潛變。 假設收斂由8增至11 mm歷時6 h，平均0.5 mm/h；同期面進3 m，空間增率1 mm/m。 快速推進時密集釋放可能被誤當加速潛變，長期停工後的持續收斂又可能被低頻量測漏掉；兩者需要不同的地工解釋與審查。~Three-dimensional face restraint diminishes with distance, while stoppages alter convergence versus time. Plotting movement against both time and face distance separates advance-related release from continuing rock creep. An assumed convergence increase from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h gives 0.5 mm/h; with 3 m advance, the spatial increment is 1 mm/m. Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings. These cases require different geotechnical interpretations and review.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設收斂由8增至11 mm歷時6 h，平均0.5 mm/h；同期面進3 m，空間增率1 mm/m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed convergence increase from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h gives 0.5 mm/h; with 3 m advance, the spatial increment is 1 mm/m.
units.verify: 同步掌子面里程、支護完成時刻與位移資料，對照停工時段是否仍有變形；以多斷面比較一致面距的行為，速率變化需連到實際事件而非只用等時間插值資料。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：快速推進時密集釋放可能被誤當加速潛變，長期停工後的持續收斂又可能被低頻量測漏掉；兩者需要不同的地工解釋與審查。~Synchronize face chainage, support completion and movement and inspect behavior during stoppages; compare sections at matching face distances and relate rate changes to actual events rather than uniformly interpolated time series. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings. These cases require different geotechnical interpretations and review.
units.failure: 快速推進時密集釋放可能被誤當加速潛變，長期停工後的持續收斂又可能被低頻量測漏掉；兩者需要不同的地工解釋與審查。~Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings. These cases require different geotechnical interpretations and review.
units.misconception: 收斂對時間增加必定代表潛變，與掌子面推進無關。~Increasing convergence with time necessarily indicates creep unrelated to face advance.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄面距與變形速率的資料來源與適用條件。同步掌子面里程、支護完成時刻與位移資料，對照停工時段是否仍有變形；以多斷面比較一致面距的行為，速率變化需連到實際事件而非只用等時間插值資料。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for face distance and movement rate. Synchronize face chainage, support completion and movement and inspect behavior during stoppages; compare sections at matching face distances and relate rate changes to actual events rather than uniformly interpolated time series.

units.anchor: 支護接觸與剛度~Support contact and stiffness
units.title: 支護接觸與剛度~Support contact and stiffness
units.mechanism: 襯砌只有與圍岩有效接觸並形成受力路徑後才提供約束，間隙閉合前的收斂未必反映材料柔弱。早齡混凝土剛度隨時間變化，收斂減慢也可能是支護成熟而非地層改善。 假設等效線性支護k=20 MN/m、接觸後位移2 mm，反力F=kδ=40 kN；接觸前不可使用此式。 有空隙時先套線性支護會高估早期反力，反之忽略成熟剛度又可能低估後期受力；收斂小也不能證明襯砌應力低。~Lining restrains ground only after contact and a load path form; movement before gap closure need not indicate weak material. Early-age stiffness changes with time, so slower convergence can reflect support maturation rather than improved geology. Assume equivalent linear support stiffness k=20 MN/m and post-contact movement 2 mm; F=kδ=40 kN, inapplicable before contact. Applying linear support across a gap overestimates early reaction, while ignoring maturing stiffness can underestimate later force. Small convergence therefore does not prove low lining stress.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等效線性支護k=20 MN/m、接觸後位移2 mm，反力F=kδ=40 kN；接觸前不可使用此式。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume equivalent linear support stiffness k=20 MN/m and post-contact movement 2 mm; F=kδ=40 kN, inapplicable before contact.
units.verify: 把收斂與支護齡期、厚度、接縫及接觸檢查相連，必要時以應變或荷重資料交叉確認；設計者需驗證剛度模型及有效受力寬度，不直接將單點位移乘任意剛度當全環載重。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：有空隙時先套線性支護會高估早期反力，反之忽略成熟剛度又可能低估後期受力；收斂小也不能證明襯砌應力低。~Relate convergence to age, thickness, joints and contact, cross-checking strain or load where appropriate; the designer verifies stiffness and effective width instead of multiplying one displacement by arbitrary stiffness to infer whole-ring load. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Applying linear support across a gap overestimates early reaction, while ignoring maturing stiffness can underestimate later force. Small convergence therefore does not prove low lining stress.
units.failure: 有空隙時先套線性支護會高估早期反力，反之忽略成熟剛度又可能低估後期受力；收斂小也不能證明襯砌應力低。~Applying linear support across a gap overestimates early reaction, while ignoring maturing stiffness can underestimate later force. Small convergence therefore does not prove low lining stress.
units.misconception: 支護剛度乘位移可在有空隙未接觸時直接算出反力。~Support stiffness times movement directly gives reaction even before a gap closes.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄支護接觸與剛度的資料來源與適用條件。把收斂與支護齡期、厚度、接縫及接觸檢查相連，必要時以應變或荷重資料交叉確認；設計者需驗證剛度模型及有效受力寬度，不直接將單點位移乘任意剛度當全環載重。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for support contact and stiffness. Relate convergence to age, thickness, joints and contact, cross-checking strain or load where appropriate; the designer verifies stiffness and effective width instead of multiplying one displacement by arbitrary stiffness to infer whole-ring load.

units.anchor: 斷面橢圓化模式~Section ovalization patterns
units.title: 斷面橢圓化模式~Section ovalization patterns
units.mechanism: 直徑在一方向縮短而另一方向增加，可能是橢圓化而非均勻收縮。幾何模式與接縫轉動、局部載重及圍岩不均有關，需保留整圈向量，避免單點最大值掩蓋成對變化。 假設水平直徑6.000變5.990 m、垂直變6.006 m，差異橢圓化幅16 mm；定義須固定。 僅量水平弦會漏掉頂底張開，最佳擬合圓又可能平均掉橢圓化；若因此宣稱斷面尺寸正常，接縫防水及局部彎矩風險會被忽略。~Shortening one diameter while another grows suggests ovalization rather than uniform shrinkage. The mode depends on joint rotation, local loads and uneven ground, requiring full-perimeter vectors instead of only the largest single reading. Assume horizontal diameter changes from 6.000 to 5.990 m while vertical becomes 6.006 m; the diameter difference is 16 mm under this stated ovalization definition. A horizontal chord alone misses vertical opening, and a best-fit circle averages away ovalization. Declaring normal geometry from that fit can overlook joint-waterproofing and local bending risks.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設水平直徑6.000變5.990 m、垂直變6.006 m，差異橢圓化幅16 mm；定義須固定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume horizontal diameter changes from 6.000 to 5.990 m while vertical becomes 6.006 m; the diameter difference is 16 mm under this stated ovalization definition.
units.verify: 用多方位反射鏡或掃描斷面擬合低階變形模式，與接縫張開及裂縫位置比較；同時報告剛體平移與形狀變化，掃描配準不得將真正的低階變形吸收到座標轉換。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：僅量水平弦會漏掉頂底張開，最佳擬合圓又可能平均掉橢圓化；若因此宣稱斷面尺寸正常，接縫防水及局部彎矩風險會被忽略。~Fit low-order modes to multiple targets or scanned profiles and compare joint opening and cracks; report rigid translation separately from shape change and prevent scan registration from absorbing genuine low-order deformation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A horizontal chord alone misses vertical opening, and a best-fit circle averages away ovalization. Declaring normal geometry from that fit can overlook joint-waterproofing and local bending risks.
units.failure: 僅量水平弦會漏掉頂底張開，最佳擬合圓又可能平均掉橢圓化；若因此宣稱斷面尺寸正常，接縫防水及局部彎矩風險會被忽略。~A horizontal chord alone misses vertical opening, and a best-fit circle averages away ovalization. Declaring normal geometry from that fit can overlook joint-waterproofing and local bending risks.
units.misconception: 把斷面最佳擬合成圓就能保留全部橢圓化資訊。~Fitting the section to a best-fit circle preserves all ovalization information.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄斷面橢圓化模式的資料來源與適用條件。用多方位反射鏡或掃描斷面擬合低階變形模式，與接縫張開及裂縫位置比較；同時報告剛體平移與形狀變化，掃描配準不得將真正的低階變形吸收到座標轉換。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for section ovalization patterns. Fit low-order modes to multiple targets or scanned profiles and compare joint opening and cracks; report rigid translation separately from shape change and prevent scan registration from absorbing genuine low-order deformation.

units.anchor: 資料延遲與回應~Data latency and response
units.title: 資料延遲與回應~Data latency and response
units.mechanism: 自動量測的價值取決於資料到達決策者的時間，感測器頻率高卻傳輸延遲仍可能錯過趨勢。資料品質、缺測與超限必須各自有狀態，不能把沒有新資料顯示成穩定綠燈。 假設採樣5 min、傳輸延遲10 min、審查15 min，最壞單次等待尺度為30 min；未含重測時間。 伺服器重送舊數據若被當新測次，曲線會看似平穩且持續更新；沒有資料新鮮度警告時，真正加速收斂可能一直無人察覺。~Automated monitoring depends on time to decision, not sensor frequency alone. High-rate acquisition with delayed transmission can miss actionable trends. Quality, missing data and exceedance need distinct states rather than presenting silence as stable green status. Assume sampling interval 5 min, transmission delay 10 min and review 15 min; a worst-case single-cycle waiting scale is 30 min, excluding remeasurement. If a server retransmits old values as new readings, the trend looks stable and continuously updated. Without a freshness warning, genuine accelerating convergence can remain undetected despite an active dashboard.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設採樣5 min、傳輸延遲10 min、審查15 min，最壞單次等待尺度為30 min；未含重測時間。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume sampling interval 5 min, transmission delay 10 min and review 15 min; a worst-case single-cycle waiting scale is 30 min, excluding remeasurement.
units.verify: 以模擬超限和斷線資料測通知、備援與責任人確認時間，核對時間戳是否使用同一時區；監測計畫需將延遲與可能變形速率比較，回應條件由主管工程師與施工團隊核准。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：伺服器重送舊數據若被當新測次，曲線會看似平穩且持續更新；沒有資料新鮮度警告時，真正加速收斂可能一直無人察覺。~Test alerts, backups and acknowledgment using simulated exceedance and dropout, checking a common timestamp zone; compare latency with plausible movement rate and obtain engineering and construction approval of the response conditions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: If a server retransmits old values as new readings, the trend looks stable and continuously updated. Without a freshness warning, genuine accelerating convergence can remain undetected despite an active dashboard.
units.failure: 伺服器重送舊數據若被當新測次，曲線會看似平穩且持續更新；沒有資料新鮮度警告時，真正加速收斂可能一直無人察覺。~If a server retransmits old values as new readings, the trend looks stable and continuously updated. Without a freshness warning, genuine accelerating convergence can remain undetected despite an active dashboard.
units.misconception: 自動監測有持續更新的畫面就代表資料必定是最新值。~A continuously updating automated display necessarily contains fresh measurements.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄資料延遲與回應的資料來源與適用條件。以模擬超限和斷線資料測通知、備援與責任人確認時間，核對時間戳是否使用同一時區；監測計畫需將延遲與可能變形速率比較，回應條件由主管工程師與施工團隊核准。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for data latency and response. Test alerts, backups and acknowledgment using simulated exceedance and dropout, checking a common timestamp zone; compare latency with plausible movement rate and obtain engineering and construction approval of the response conditions.

units.anchor: 收斂反分析與交接~Convergence back-analysis and handover
units.title: 收斂反分析與交接~Convergence back-analysis and handover
units.mechanism: 位移反分析可能由不同剛度與荷重組合得到相似曲線，故參數不一定唯一。應結合地質、支護應變及施工時序限制解空間，交接報告保留可替代解釋，讓後續工程知道哪些推論仍需驗證。 假設模型A與B都預測10 mm但實測10.5 mm，兩者殘差皆0.5 mm；相同擬合誤差不能證明機制相同。 用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。~Different stiffness-load combinations can fit similar convergence histories, making back-analysis nonunique. Geology, support strain and construction sequence constrain solutions; handover retains alternative interpretations and identifies what still requires verification. If assumed models A and B predict 10 mm against 10.5 mm observed, both residuals are 0.5 mm; equal fit error does not establish the same mechanism. Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設模型A與B都預測10 mm但實測10.5 mm，兩者殘差皆0.5 mm；相同擬合誤差不能證明機制相同。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If assumed models A and B predict 10 mm against 10.5 mm observed, both residuals are 0.5 mm; equal fit error does not establish the same mechanism.
units.verify: 保留校準用與獨立驗證用斷面，檢查模型能否預測未參與擬合的時間或位置；交接量測原始檔、參數範圍與失效條件，由設計及監測負責人共同確認可外推範圍。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。~Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes.
units.failure: 用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。~Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes.
units.misconception: 兩個模型同樣吻合收斂曲線，就表示其力學機制相同。~Two models fitting convergence equally well necessarily use the same physical mechanism.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄收斂反分析與交接的資料來源與適用條件。保留校準用與獨立驗證用斷面，檢查模型能否預測未參與擬合的時間或位置；交接量測原始檔、參數範圍與失效條件，由設計及監測負責人共同確認可外推範圍。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for convergence back-analysis and handover. Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示用多方向位移、量測基準與支護時序辨識隧道收斂機制需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why identify convergence mechanisms through multidirectional movement, survey references and support timing requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015.

教學量化備忘：假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured.

教學量化備忘：假設視距100 m、角度誤差5 arcsec，線性誤差100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed sight distance 100 m and angular error 5 arcsec, linear error is 100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm.
教學量化備忘：假設鋼尺α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長10 m、溫差10 K，ΔL=αLΔT=1.2 mm；未含垂度。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume steel-tape α=12×10⁻⁶/K, length 10 m and temperature change 10 K; ΔL=1.2 mm, excluding sag.

教學量化備忘：假設三點皆向右5 mm且弦長不變，可能為共同平移；差分位移5−5=0 mm，不能據此宣稱絕對不動。~Teaching quantitative note: If three assumed targets all move 5 mm right with unchanged chords, their differential movement is zero; this does not demonstrate absolute stability.

教學量化備忘：假設收斂由8增至11 mm歷時6 h，平均0.5 mm/h；同期面進3 m，空間增率1 mm/m。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed convergence increase from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h gives 0.5 mm/h; with 3 m advance, the spatial increment is 1 mm/m.
